subject: Renewal: Reserved pool TPS guarantee & burst capacity addendum
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Reserved pool TPS guarantee & burst capacity addendum

Hi Samantha / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As we discussed, Acme's renewal window is coming up and you'd like to lock in additional reserved capacity for Q4 usage spikes. To keep the renewal moving (and to get you pricing for the committed pool), I attached an initial addendum draft that defines committed tokens/sec (steady-state) and a separate short-duration burst allowance. Key asks from our side to move this forward: 

- Confirm the committed TPS target you want guaranteed (examples below are placeholders).
- Confirm expected monthly burst budget (tokens) and maximum burst duration per minute.
- Any procurement constraints (PO number, invoicing cadence, acceptance tests).
- Timeline for signature — we need execution by 2027-08-25 to meet the launch window.

Attached: redwood-tps-addendum-draft.pdf (draft language + measurement methodology).

Quick proposal to accelerate: we can offer a two-tier guarantee: a committed pool at X tokens/sec (SLA with monthly availability target) plus a burst credit bucket that allows short spikes up to Y tokens/sec for up to Z seconds per minute. Pricing uplift will be applied to the committed pool; burst consumption billed at metered rate or deducted from committed credits.

If this aligns, we'll follow up with formal SLO wording and a DocuSign-ready addendum.

Thanks — happy to jump on another 20-min call if you want to walk the draft line-by-line.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 11:25:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal: Reserved pool TPS guarantee & burst capacity addendum

Thanks Rohan — appreciate the draft. A few clarifying notes from Acme's side: 

1) Committed vs burst: We need a firm committed TPS for sustained inference (we're planning ~150k tokens/sec aggregate steady-state across regions) and a burst capability for model A/B experiments that will push us to ~350k tokens/sec for short windows.

2) Measurement / penalties: The procurement team will need clear measurement windows and service-credit language if Redwood misses the committed TPS. Prefer monthly calculation with 5-min sampling windows and a 99.95% availability target for the committed pool.

3) Pre-warm / scale: We need a guaranteed pre-warm pathway (48 hour notice acceptable) to ensure model caches and KV warmers are provisioned before major campaigns.

4) Auditability: access to per-request token logs and per-route latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) is required for our SREs. These must be retained for 12 months.

5) Pricing: we expect the committed pool to be quoted as a monthly flat rate + token overage rate. Please include the uplift for the committed SLA and burst credits as separate line items.

6) Timeline: Procurement needs the signed addendum + PO to invoice by 2027-09-01.

Attaching Acme's capacity plan for reference: acme-capacity-plan.xlsx

Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Ops, Acme Robotics
samantha.lee@acme.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: Reserved pool TPS guarantee & burst capacity addendum

Rohan / Marissa — draft SLO language below. I kept it scoped to what Acme asked for; legal can run a final pass but this should be sufficient for procurement to evaluate. I've attached a redline doc with line-by-line edits (slo-redline.docx).

--- DRAFT ADDENDUM SNIPPET ---
1) Definitions:
   a) "Committed TPS" means the number of tokens per second that Redwood guarantees for the reserved pool, measured as the median tokens/sec across all worker nodes associated with the pool, sampled at 1-second resolution and aggregated into non-overlapping 5-minute windows.

   b) "Burst Credits" means a separate bucket of token credits allocated per billing period that may be applied to short-term spikes. A single burst event is limited to a maximum sustained rate of 350,000 tokens/sec for up to 120 seconds. Bucket consumption is reported in tokens and is exhausted before overage billing applies.

2) SLO and Measurement:
   - Committed TPS: 150,000 tokens/sec (example; to be finalized). Measurement period: monthly. Availability target: 99.95% of 5-minute windows in the month where measured throughput >= 90% of Committed TPS.
   - Sampling windows: 5-minute non-overlapping windows; windows with scheduled maintenance (pre-notified >= 48 hours) are excluded.

3) Remedies:
   - Service credits are applied when the monthly availability target is missed. Credit schedule: 5% monthly fee credit for single missed month, escalating to 15% for repeated misses (see attached schedule).

4) Pre-warm and Operational Runbooks:
   - Redwood will honor a 48-hour pre-warm request that includes cache-warming and KV prefetch steps described in Runbook v1. Pre-warm requests should be submitted to support@redwood.com and include expected start time, target models, and anticipated traffic profile.

5) Auditability and Logging:
   - Per-request token usage, route-level latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), and sampling exports will be provided via a secure S3 link and retained for 12 months.

6) Fallback Behavior:
   - If capacity constraints prevent meeting Committed TPS, Redwood will: (i) automatically route to a compatible lower-throughput model variant, (ii) use cached responses where applicable, and (iii) surface a routed-fallback event to Acme's SREs with estimated impact. These behaviors are not considered SLA breaches if invoked during force majeure or scheduled maintenance.

--- end snippet ---

Next steps I recommend: finalize the numeric Committed TPS and burst bucket size (Acme gave targets; we should confirm), Marissa to finalize pricing, then we package the redline + DocuSign link for signature.
